name: CogeniusVariableSave
description: Saves pipeline variables matching one or more prefixes to .json files so they can be loaded later (Windows, Linux and macOS).
author: Cogenius

inputs.name: prefixes
inputs.label: Prefixes
inputs.helpMarkDown: Comma delimited list of variable prefixes to save (matched case-insensitively against the agent environment, e.g. `BUILD` matches `BUILD_BUILDNUMBER`). One `meta-<prefix>.json` file is written per prefix.

inputs.name: outpath
inputs.label: Output path
inputs.helpMarkDown: Folder in which the `meta-<prefix>.json` files are stored.
